note: Every data source of the twin. kind: real | estimated | simulated | restricted. Endpoints were tested on 2026-11-13 unless status says otherwise.

roma_geoserver.what: PRG, Carta per la Qualita, Rete Ecologica, UNESCO, schools, hospitals, municipi, sports facilities
roma_geoserver.licence: not stated in capabilities; credit Roma Capitale - GeoPortale (CC BY assumed, confidence 60)

lazio_geoserver.what: PTPR Tavola A/B, Natura 2000, AGEA orthophotos

osm.what: Roads, POIs, playgrounds, care homes, masts, private sports venues
osm.status: not tested from the research sandbox

mase_lidar.what: 1 m surface and terrain models (2008-2011), about a third of the centre along the Tiber

megascenes.what: About 896 Rome landmark photo scenes with camera poses
megascenes.redistribution: derived models with attribution; not raw photos

eea_hourly.what: Hourly air quality, 13 Rome NO2 points

roma_ckan.what: 365 open datasets (Wi-Fi sessions, accidents, sports centres 2018...)
roma_ckan.licence: mostly CC BY; exclude the 11 non-commercial ones

cartoradio_grid.what: National estimated E-field grid in V/m, 100 m cells (EPSG:3857), float32, nodata -9999
cartoradio_grid.access: cloud-optimised GeoTIFF, read the Rome window by byte range at runtime
cartoradio_grid.licence: legal notes forbid reuse; written consent from MIMIT/FUB pending (cartoradio@fub.it)

sim_register.what: Antenna installation register seeded from OpenCelliD and OSM
sim_register.licence: inherits CC BY-SA / ODbL from its seeds

istat_census.what: ISTAT 2021 census sections of Roma Capitale (basi territoriali, Lazio file) joined with residents and age classes per section (census at 31 Dec 2021)

derived.what: Layers built from other processed layers by twin/ingest (e.g. the merged sensitive_sites layer); data_kind is inherited from the inputs
derived.licence: inherits the licences of its inputs (CC BY for Roma/ISTAT layers, ODbL for OSM rows)

lazio_open_data.what: Regione Lazio open data portal (CKAN): accredited private health facilities with coordinates
lazio_open_data.licence: Regione Lazio open data; licence not stated on this dataset (C=60), facility names and positions only are kept

indicepa.what: IndicePA (IPA), national register of public administrations: head-office addresses, geocoded offline on OSM addr:* tags

ispra_flood.what: ISPRA national mosaic of flood hazard areas, PGRA scenarios P3/P2/P1 (v5.0, 2020)
ispra_flood.status: verified (downloaded 2026-11-13); the sdi.isprambiente.it WFS resets cloud connections

copernicus_hrl.what: Copernicus HRL Imperviousness Density 2018 (share of sealed soil, 0-100 %)
copernicus_hrl.licence: Copernicus open data, free reuse with attribution

salute_open_data.what: Ministry of Health open data: hospital beds per structure 2023, family health centres 2022, national pharmacy register (daily); addresses geocoded offline on OSM

salute_asl.what: Ministry of Health open data: ASL-municipio correspondence with residents 2024 and ASL structures/activity 2022, joined to the Roma Capitale municipi

ispra_landslide.what: ISPRA national mosaic of PAI landslide hazard areas (2025)

ispra_soil_change.what: ISPRA land consumption monitoring: new sealed soil 2023-2024 (points)

urban_zones.notes: 155 zones; code_zu is the zone code, municipi the municipio

census_sections.notes: ISTAT 2021 census sections of Roma Capitale with residents and children 0-14 (census at 31 Dec 2021)

ptpr_paesaggi_roma.notes: PTPR Tavola A cascaded from Lazio; the full layer covers the whole region

care_homes_osm.notes: No official RSA layer exists; OSM is incomplete

playgrounds_osm.notes: No official playground layer exists; OSM is incomplete

masts_osm.notes: About 191 mobile masts in Roma Capitale were counted earlier (C=80)

sitap_art136_cd.error: URLError: <urlopen error [Errno 104] Connection reset by peer>

sitap_art136_ab.notes: type name guessed from the c_d layer; marked not_available if wrong
sitap_art136_ab.error: URLError: <urlopen error [Errno 104] Connection reset by peer>

osm_sports.notes: Private and public sports venues from OSM; also saved as Overpass-style JSON for WS10

ptp_beni_art134_c.notes: Beni paesaggistici art. 134 c.1 lett. c (PTP 15/12)

hazardous_sites.notes: Seveso (D.Lgs. 105/2015) plants, nuclear reactor, landfills, waste storage, car breakers

osm_sensitive_pois.notes: Gap filler only; official layers win when both describe the same site

sensitive_sites.notes: Official layers first, OSM fills gaps; each row says its source layer and provenance

health_accredited_lazio.notes: Private health facilities accredited by Regione Lazio (list of 26/11/2014, with coordinates). Old list: some may have closed or moved (C=70).

public_bodies_ipa.notes: Head offices of national and local public bodies in Rome from IndicePA; position from OSM addresses (geocode_quality address = exact house number, street = centre of the street)

land_use_2016.notes: Regione Lazio land use map 1:25,000, 2016 update (Corine-style classes)

flood_hazard_pgra.notes: P3 = frequent floods (return period 20-50 years), P2 = 100-200 years, P1 = rare or extreme events. Areas overlap: a P3 area is also inside P2 and P1.

imperviousness_2018.notes: Share of sealed soil per 20 m pixel, 0-100 %, 255 = no data. Native 10 m resampled by the server with nearest neighbour.

road_underpasses_osm.notes: Road sections below ground level (tunnel or layer < 0) where water collects; OSM mapping is incomplete (C=70)

rivers_osm.notes: River, stream and canal centrelines (relations skipped; their member ways are included)

hospital_beds_2023.notes: Hospitals and accredited private clinics in Rome with beds on 1 Jan 2023 (acute, rehabilitation, long-term care). Positions geocoded on OSM addresses.

consultori_roma.notes: Family health centres (consultori familiari) in Rome, 2022 register

pharmacies_roma.notes: Open pharmacies in Rome from the national register (updated daily). The register's own coordinates are often wrong (e.g. Testaccio placed in Tiburtino), so the address is geocoded on OSM instead.

asl_roma.notes: ASL Roma 1, 2, 3 as unions of their municipi, with 2024 residents, 2022 ASL activity figures and facility counts. The Ministry's 2022 table gives ROMA 1 and ROMA 2 identical GP and paediatrician figures (918 / 171): likely a copy error in the source (C=40 for those two values).

landslide_hazard_pai.notes: PAI landslide hazard classes as in the ISPRA mosaic: P4 very high, P3 high, P2 medium, P1 moderate, AA attention areas

soil_sealing_change_2024.notes: Points where ISPRA found new sealed soil between 2023 and 2024 (area_ha = size of the change); where the city is growing

traffic_sensors.notes: Positions of Roma Mobilita traffic sensors at signalised junctions (APPARATO = controller, SENSORE = detector, PEDONALE = pedestrian detector). Positions only, no counts.

ztl_green_belt_gates.notes: Camera gates of the Fascia Verde low-emission zone

drinking_fountains.notes: Public drinking fountains (nasoni) published with the climate-shelter map; for heat-wave use cases

landslide_areas_roma.notes: Landslide areas mapped by Roma Capitale civil protection

street_trees_m8.notes: Tree census with species for municipio VIII only (the only municipio published)
